examples.text: Der Herbststurm entlaubte die Bäume vollends.
Im Vietnamkrieg entlaubten die Amerikaner ganze Wälder.

glosses: To remove foliage from (one or more plants), most often with a chemical agent.

examples.text: Agent Orange was used to defoliate jungle vegetation.
These leaves are the moth’s only source of food, and if left unchecked, the caterpillars can completely defoliate a single mighty tree.
